hook: Your boat on this river would suddenly start drifting backwards.
title: A River That Flows Backwards Every Year
description:
Cambodia's Tonle Sap river changes direction twice a year. In the dry season it drains the lake into the Mekong. When the monsoon swells the Mekong, the water pushes back up into the lake.

#Shorts #Geography #Cambodia
